## Biographical Information

mother of Sophia Jane Harrison

The friendship between the Collinsons and CMY's mother's family is described by her in Coleridge, <i>[Life](../other_books/otherbook_40.qmd)</i> 31-2;  and also in the account she wrote of the novels of Julia (Collinson) Stretton (daughter of Amelia Collinson) in <i>[Women Novelists of Queen Victoria's Reign](../cmy_books/cmybook_244.qmd)</i>.
